en.headline: Immigration Department prepares for first inbound peak at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Officials expect heavy return traffic this afternoon and evening on the final day of the Chung Yeung holiday and are urging early registration for co-location clearance.
body: The Immigration Department said it expects the new Huanggang Port to see its first major inbound peak this afternoon and evening as travellers return from the mainland on the last day of the Chung Yeung Festival long weekend.

Deputy Commander of the Lok Ma Chau Control Division Yiu Ka-wai said officers would monitor passenger flow in real time and adjust manpower flexibly to speed up clearance. The department appealed to eligible users of the co-location e-channels to register in advance through the Hong Kong e-Channel mobile app, noting that parents or guardians can also register children aged 7 to 17.

Travellers were advised to check the latest information on the Security Bureau’s Easy Boundary platform before setting out, plan journeys early, choose suitable control points and avoid peak periods. The Transport Department said 120 franchised buses, 130 cross-boundary buses and 40 public light buses are in service, with operators instructed to add special short-turn trips that could run as frequently as every two to three minutes at busy times.
Commissioner for Transport Mable Chan inspected the public transport interchange at the port earlier in the day to review preparations for the expected return traffic.

zh.headline: 入境處料新皇崗口岸下午至晚上迎首個入境高峰 籲預先登記合作查驗
zh.dek: 重陽節長周末最後一日，入境處預計下午至傍晚回港人流增多，會靈活調配人手，並呼籲合資格市民預先登記合作查驗e道。
body: 入境處表示，新皇崗口岸預計今天下午至晚上迎來開通後首個入境高峰，因應重陽節長周末最後一日大批市民從內地返港。
落馬洲管制科副指揮官容嘉蔚指，處方會實時監察口岸情況，因應客流靈活調配人手，加快疏導人潮。處方呼籲合資格使用合作查驗e道的市民，出行前透過「香港e道」流動應用程式預先登記，父母或監護人亦可為7至17歲子女登記。
入境處建議旅客出行前透過保安局「口岸通」平台查閱各管制站最新出入境資訊，及早規劃行程，選擇合適管制站，避免繁忙時段過關。運輸署表示，今天共有120輛專營巴士、130輛跨境巴士及40輛專線小巴投入服務，並已指示專營巴士營辦商加開特別短途班次，繁忙時間最密可達每2至3分鐘一班。
運輸署署長謝詠誼上午到皇崗口岸公共運輸交匯處視察，聽取團隊匯報準備情況，確保交通安排可應付回港高峰。
